items.title: Ancient Greek History for Sleep: An Evening in Athens by Lamplight (48 Min)
items.description:
Spend a slow, peaceful evening in ancient Athens in the age of Pericles. Watch Mount Hymettus turn violet from the rock of the Pnyx, wander through the Agora as the lamps are lit along the Painted Stoa, share a simple supper in a family courtyard, listen to a quiet lyre at a dinner among friends, and climb to the Parthenon under the moon.

Slow narration, soft ambient sound and a long quiet tail at the end, so you can let go whenever you are ready.
